name: Ask questions
definition: Open-ended questions that probe thinking — including questions students learn to ask of themselves.

name: Be explicit
definition: Naming the learning intention and the thinking strategy directly, rather than leaving either implicit.

name: Plan ahead
definition: Using a checklist, organiser or planned sequence of steps before starting, not while starting.

name: Model your thinking
definition: Thinking aloud — including the moment of getting stuck, and what you do about it.

name: Challenge students
definition: Introducing a harder or unfamiliar task once confidence is established, to test whether thinking transfers.

name: Evaluate progress
definition: Reflecting on and rating the thinking process itself, separately from whether the answer was right.

name: Promote collaboration
definition: Comparing how different people reasoned through the same problem.

name: Keep practising
definition: Repeating the same thinking routine across different content until it becomes durable.

name: Regularly check in
definition: Periodically checking whether a thinking habit is becoming independent, not just present when prompted.
